barber.bio: Kobus Von Willingh has spent a decade perfecting his craft behind the chair. Known for clean fades, sharp line-ups, and cuts tailored to you — not just the trend — he brings old-school technique and modern style to every appointment. Calm, focused, and detail-driven, Kobus makes sure you leave looking sharp and feeling confident.
